name: Hotel Robe
summary: Landscape, one continuous shot in a warm luxury hotel room. In an open satin robe, topless, with a lace thong and stockings, she walks toward the camera, plays with her hair, turns to show her back, reaches out to him and opens the robe wide. 2026-10-29: legs slowed - one slow action each, 'slowly' in every line, a steady camera in place of the handheld sway, and as few legs as the 6 s cap allows. The face blurred mid-gesture and drifted a little more at every handoff.

start.composition: a wide photo at standing eye level, she stands a few steps away in the middle of the room facing the camera, her whole body in frame, smiling at him
start.outfit: an open champagne satin robe falling off her shoulders, topless, an ivory lace thong with a matching garter belt and sheer ivory stockings
start.setting: warm lamplight, in a luxury hotel suite with a made king bed, wood-panelled walls, a leather armchair and soft sconces

legs: she walks slowly toward the camera, smiling, the robe slipping off her shoulders
she slowly turns to look back over her shoulder at the camera, the robe sliding down her back
she slowly turns back to face the camera, takes the edges of the robe and opens it wide, holding eye contact
leg_suffix: steady camera at standing eye level, she moves slowly and gently, small smooth movements, continuous shot, no cuts
video_negative: camera cut, scene change, morphing, face change, extra fingers, distorted hands, flicker, different person
script:
[0-2s] Hello, darling.
[3-4s] Like what you see?
[4-11s] So good.
[11-13s] Your turn.
